dog.description_text: Matilda is a 3 year old female and ready for her forever home! She is a very special kitty and she’s now ready to join a loving, calm, and aligned forever home. She loves to play and watch cat tv. Matilda is a sensitive, shy, intuitive cat who does best in a peaceful environment. She is smart and curious. Matilda will flourish with someone patient, gentle, and kind. A solo-cat home is ideal so she can feel safe and bloom at her own pace :)
dog.name: Matilda
